name: Example — schema reference
description: Schema reference pack. Shows every field. Don't load this for actual work — go to one of the practical packs (claude-code-basic, dual-claude-pair, codebase-explorer, writing-helper, debug-session, trading-workflow). See SCHEMA.md for the full field-by-field breakdown.

tabs.label: Claude Code
startCommands: echo 'Schema reference. Replace this with your real setup before sharing.'

env_hints.purpose: If you saved your key on the welcome screen, it's auto-injected. Otherwise paste it in the shell.

notes: cwd: absolute path, null for user home, or templated like ${USERPROFILE}/Documents/myrepo (any process env var resolves).
systemPrompt: optional per-tab string written to the PTY 2s after startCommands run. Used to prime Claude / the agent in that tab.
